title: Acute and Chronic Hypercapnia (CO2 Toxicity & ECLSS Scrubbing Degradation)
nasa_citations: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev D [V2 6004]; OCHMO-TB-004; JSC-48522
primary_vital_trends: RR = RR_base + 0.45*dCO2; HR = HR_base + 1.8*dCO2; SBP = SBP_base + 1.4*dCO2; HRV = HRV_base - 2.2*dCO2
symptoms_summary: Throbbing frontal headache, facial flushing, dry cough, blurred vision, cognitive slowing, trigeminal paresthesia (>4.5 mmHg)
checs_medications: Ibuprofen 400-600 mg PO or Acetaminophen 325-650 mg PO
strict_contraindication: STRICT CONTRAINDICATION: Do NOT administer opioids (Hydrocodone/Hydromorphone) — suppresses central respiratory drive and worsens CO2 retention.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Relocate crew from low-ventilation compartment & deploy portable fan | 2. Switch ECLSS to CAMRAS amine bed / purge CDRA zeolite bed | 3. Deploy 100% O2 mask (RSP) & run i-STAT blood gas (MDP) if ppCO2 > 5.0 mmHg | 4. Give Ibuprofen 400mg PO (CMP) & shift diet RQ to 0.85

title: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-Ocular Syndrome (SANS)
nasa_citations: NASA HRP Evidence Book: SANS; NASA SANS CPG; JSC-48522
primary_vital_trends: RNFL(d) = 95 + 18*ln(1 + (d-15)/30) um; RefractionShift = +0.25*floor((d-21)/25) D; ChoroidVolume +0.37 mm3
symptoms_summary: Progressive near-vision blurriness, dull retro-orbital pressure (worsened by CO2), metamorphopsia, scotomas
strict_contraindication: Screen anterior chamber angle before mydriasis; monitor electrolytes and renal stone risk on Acetazolamide.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Perform OCT (RNFL > 105 um), Optical Biometry, Tonometry & Fundoscopy (MDP) | 2. Fit Space Anticipation Glasses (+0.75 to +1.50 D) | 3. Initiate nightly Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) | 4. Clamp cabin ppCO2 < 2.5 mmHg & moderate peak ARED Valsalva loads

title: Orthostatic Intolerance and Gravitational Transition Pre-Syncope
primary_vital_trends: SBP(t) = 112 - 28*(1-exp(-t/1.8)) - step(t-4)*18*(t-4); HR spikes to 108 bpm then drops <50 bpm
symptoms_summary: Postural lightheadedness, dizziness, palpitations, tunnel vision ('graying out'), diaphoresis, nausea, impending syncope
checs_medications: 0.9% Normal Saline 500-1000 mL IV; AstroAde/Salt Tablets PO; Ondansetron 4mg ODT
strict_contraindication: Monitor for fluid volume overload; Promethazine may cause sedation.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Command immediate supine legs-elevated (Trendelenburg) posture | 2. Breathe through Inspiratory Threshold Valve (ITV/ITD, RSP) to boost stroke volume | 3. Don compression garments & execute NASA Fluid Loading Protocol | 4. Infuse 500-1000 mL 0.9% Normal Saline IV (ISP)

title: Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) from Solar Particle Event (SPE)
nasa_citations: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 [V1 4030]; NASA DONKI API (/SEP & /FLR); JSC-48522
primary_vital_trends: BFO Dose Weibull surge; CBT +1.2 C; HR +28 bpm; SBP -16 mmHg; ALC(t) = 2100*exp(-0.035*D*t)
symptoms_summary: Sudden anorexia, severe nausea, repetitive vomiting, acute fatigue, headache, parotid tenderness, skin erythema
checs_medications: Ondansetron 4-8 mg ODT/IV; Levofloxacin 500mg PO; Valacyclovir; Fluconazole; Acetaminophen
strict_contraindication: STRICT CONTRAINDICATION: Avoid Aspirin and NSAIDs (Ibuprofen/Ketorolac) — radiation thrombocytopenia creates severe GI hemorrhage risk.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. ALARA Protocol: Abort EVA on DONKI /SEP or /FLR alert & enter shielded Storm Shelter | 2. Give Ondansetron 4-8mg ODT/IV & start 0.9% Normal Saline IV (ISP) | 3. Run serial C2M2 offline CBC assays every 6 hours | 4. Start prophylactic antimicrobials & use Acetaminophen (NO NSAIDs)

title: EVA Thermal Strain ('Space Fever'), Dehydration, and Decompression Sickness (DCS)
symptoms_summary: Profuse cranial sweat pooling, visor fogging, muscle cramps, joint pain ('the bends'), substernal chest pain, cough ('the chokes')
checs_medications: 100% Oxygen; 0.9% Normal Saline 1-2 L IV; Ibuprofen 600mg PO / Ketorolac 30mg IV
strict_contraindication: Rule out neurological hemorrhage before high-dose Ketorolac.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Pause EVA work (VO2 < 1000 mL/min) & set LCVG cooling to max | 2. Abort EVA, ingress airlock & repressurize to 101.3 kPa (14.7 psia) | 3. Doff suit & apply chilled water packs until CBT < 38.0 C | 4. Administer 100% O2 via tight mask (RSP) & 1-2 L Normal Saline IV (ISP)

title: Circadian Desynchrony, Sleep Fragmentation, and Behavioral Asthenia
nasa_citations: NASA Spaceflight Standard Measures (SSM); NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6012]; CHeCS
primary_vital_trends: SOL > 48 min; WASO > 65 min; TST < 5.0 hr; nocturnal CBT plateau 37.7 C; nocturnal HR 65 bpm; HRV < 18 ms
symptoms_summary: Insomnia, frequent awakenings, daytime cognitive fog (+30% slower CTB reaction), irritability, anxiety/agitation
checs_medications: Melatonin 3-5mg PO; Zaleplon 5-10mg PO; Zolpidem 5-10mg PO; Modafinil/Caffeine
strict_contraindication: If benzodiazepines (Lorazepam/Diazepam) are used for acute agitation, stage Flumazenil 0.1 mg/mL (EMTP) for reversal.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Set 480nm blue-enriched morning light & blue-depleted evening light | 2. Cool Crew Quarters to 18-20 C ([V2 6012]) & verify ppCO2 < 2.5 mmHg | 3. Administer Melatonin 3mg or Zaleplon 5-10mg at bedtime (OMP) | 4. Activate C2M2 offline VR/CBT behavioral modules

title: Spaceflight Venous Thromboembolism (IJV Thrombosis) and Cardiac Arrhythmia
nasa_citations: ISS Vascular Contingency Pack Protocol; JSC-48522 (ACLS / CMRS)
primary_vital_trends: IJV clot: HR 84 bpm, BP 128/82; PE branch: HR 128, SpO2 88%; VT branch: wide-QRS HR 185 bpm
symptoms_summary: Unilateral neck fullness/ache, facial congestion; PE/VT: sudden pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations, presyncope
checs_medications: Enoxaparin SC -> Apixaban PO; Protamine & PCC reversals; Metoprolol, Nitroglycerin, Epinephrine
strict_contraindication: HIGH TRAUMA BLEED RISK: Immediately restrict EVA and high-load ARED exercise; stage Protamine (for Enoxaparin) and PCC (for Apixaban).
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Perform AI-guided neck ultrasound to confirm IJV thrombus (MDP) | 2. Initiate Enoxaparin SC followed by oral Apixaban (VCP) | 3. Lock out EVA & high-load ARED exercise; stage Protamine/PCC reversals | 4. If VT/VF arrest: isolate on CMRS, defibrillate (AED/Zoll) & give Epinephrine (EMTP)

title: Early-Mission Space Adaptation Syndrome (SAS), Rhinosinusitis, and Acute Urinary Retention
nasa_citations: ISS Medical Checklist JSC-48522; NASA IMM CLIFFs
primary_vital_trends: Pre-emesis vagal HR dips (48 bpm); Retention: SBP = 112 + 2.8*t_ret, HR = 64 + 3.2*t_ret, bladder > 600 mL
symptoms_summary: Severe motion nausea/vomiting, pallor, nasal congestion ('space stuffies'), suprapubic pain & inability to void (>8 hr)
checs_medications: Promethazine 25-50mg + Caffeine 100-200mg; Ondansetron 4mg; Pseudoephedrine; Tamsulosin 0.4mg; Lidocaine Jelly
checs_pack: CMP, OMP, TIMP, Minor Treatment Pack (MTP)
strict_contraindication: Anticholinergic antiemetics (Promethazine/Meclizine) precipitate urinary retention in microgravity — monitor bladder volume.
autonomous_checklist_steps: 1. Minimize head pitch/roll & give Ondansetron 4mg or Promethazine 25mg + Caffeine | 2. Give Pseudoephedrine PO & Oxymetazoline spray (<=3 days) for sinus congestion | 3. Perform AI bladder ultrasound (MDP) & give Tamsulosin 0.4mg PO (OMP) | 4. If bladder > 500 mL: perform sterile catheterization per JSC-48522 (MTP)
